h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kirari Suleman Nagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kirari Suleman Nagar

items.pText: Open ground is scarce in Kirari Suleman Nagar, one of the most crowded parts of north-west Delhi. When a school, a resident welfare association or a builder here sets aside space for children, it is usually a small plot boxed in by buildings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for sites like these at our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away, and sends it to Delhi by road.

Small sites need careful planning more than big budgets. Send us the length and width of the plot, the age group of the children and a few photos, and we will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Please also tell us how wide the approach lane is, because larger play systems are assembled on site. Our installation team or a dealer in the Delhi region then sets everything up, self-standing or grouted.

richText.heading: Fitting a playground into a small Delhi plot

c: On a tight plot, choose pieces that give a lot of play per square foot. A compact multi play system such as
combines a slide, steps and a deck in one footprint, and two or three
fill the corners for the youngest children. Leave the marked safe zone clear of walls, gates and parked scooters.
Delhi swings from hot, dusty summers to cold, foggy winters, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic that handle both. For adults in the same colony, see our

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Kirari Suleman Nagar?
items.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai, send it to Delhi by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in the region. Share photos of the approach lane so we can plan the delivery.

items.q: What can we fit in a play area the size of a single plot?
items.a: Usually a compact multi play system and a few spring riders or a see-saw. Send the exact measurements and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing before you approve anything.

items.q: Will the equipment cope with Delhi's summer heat and winter fog?
items.a: Galvanised steel resists rust through damp winter months, and roto-moulded plastic does not corrode. In summer, a shaded spot keeps slide surfaces comfortable for children in the afternoon.
